title: Mochi Garden care profile — one KEPT individual (#28)
description: Raising state is per-INDIVIDUAL, never per-species (individual-variation doctrine). The careLog is the save truth; the profile is derived from it. Axis display names are PROPOSED, not canon — slots are keyed axis1..axis5 so a naming pass renames display strings without touching data. All numeric rules are null until an owner/balance pass.

speciesId.description: Join to species.json. Species data declares garden eligibility + garden asset ids only; raising state never lives there.

axes.description: Five-axis care shape (documented Chao architecture). Axis display names: PROPOSED, pending owner lock.

value.description: -1..+1 steering value; pole names and in-world framing are OPEN (THE SECRET discipline: production holds the axis, in-world text does not lecture it).

refillBy.description: Activity ids; the Garden activity list itself is OPEN (canon names garden interactions only in prose).

rules.description: Which axis profile selects which form. Null = OPEN.

growthReads.description: Profile is READ at growth stages (never consumed) to select presentation from the repo's existing per-species garden assets.

careLog.description: Append-only. The profile derives from this log, never the reverse (derived-never-stored discipline, cf. event/flag architecture).
